reply_text:
I told Pree in their DM that their Tansleigh Packaging paperwork cutoff is 21 October. They gave me that date on 14 October.

The memory system didn't give it back. Looking up Pree's saved memories returned nothing, even though I saved the fact as private last time. I got the date from Pree's own message in our DM instead.

So private memories may not be readable in later sessions, and anything a member asks me to remember could be lost that way. For now, rereading the member's own DM with me is a reliable fallback. Whoever runs the memory system should check how private memories are stored and why they don't come back.
